clips.prompt: Cinematic hand-drawn 2D anime modern forensic mystery, same series. Dark cinematic 2D anime, NOT live action or 3D. Jian Ci: pale adult black-haired forensic pathologist, white coat over black turtleneck, black gloves, quiet measured Mandarin. Lin Qian: adult police detective with short straight black bob, navy police jacket, black gloves, calm low-mid Mandarin. Zhou Qiao: adult male digital-forensics officer, neat dark hair, dark field jacket, glasses and a small hearing aid, precise Mandarin. Qi Yun: adult male maintenance worker, late twenties, short untidy dark hair, charcoal work jacket, exhausted but alert; he is a witness, NOT established as killer. Same small third-floor bedroom: FLAT gray tile floor, low cream mattress and white mug LEFT, brown wardrobe RIGHT. Its RIGHT leaf is already OPEN on a normal right hinge. Behind its removed rear panel is a shallow level maintenance recess: brick wall, vertical pipes and warm work lamp. One BLACK TOUCHSCREEN PHONE stays on the same low brick ledge unless evidence handling is explicitly shown. No indoor stairs, railings, teleportation, moving wardrobe, portals, new rooms, horror monster, gore, text, subtitles, watermark, random extra dialogue, changing faces, phone turning into keypad phone, or magical evidence. Keep essential action centered with safe title/subtitle margins. Chinese dialogue only when quoted; quiet room ambience, no music. Start exactly after Episode 3: Qi Yun remains crouched in the recess with both empty hands raised; Lin stays outside the opening and Jian behind her. 0-3.4s Lin says “别动。先报名字。” Qi Yun does not move forward. 3.4-6.6s close on Qi Yun; he says “祁昀，楼里维修工。” 6.6-10s Jian observes from outside, no touching and no supernatural display; he says “林浅，叫救护和取证一起上来。”

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.en: Don't move. Give me your name first.

subtitles.speaker: 检刺
subtitles.zh: 林浅，叫救护和取证一起上来。
subtitles.en: Lin Qian, get medical aid and forensics up here.

subtitles.speaker: 祁昀
subtitles.en: The building manager is looking for me.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.en: The phone is in place. Nobody touched it.

subtitles.speaker: 周峤
subtitles.en: Document its position first, then make an image.

subtitles.speaker: 检刺
subtitles.zh: 他手上的灰，是刚沾上的。
subtitles.en: The dust on his hand is fresh.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.en: Why is the building manager looking for you?

subtitles.speaker: 祁昀
subtitles.zh: 他昨晚把这里重新封过。
subtitles.en: He sealed this place up again last night.

subtitles.speaker: 祁昀
subtitles.zh: 顾晴昨晚打给我，说别开门。
subtitles.en: Gu Qing called me last night. She said not to open the door.
